### What?

Fixed ISR cache lifetime persistence for Pages Router pages using the
default `FileSystemCache` implementation.

### Why?

Pages Router ISR cache entries did not persist their revalidation
interval to disk. After restarting the server, the cache lifetime
defaulted to 1 second instead of the configured `revalidate` value.

immediately after a restart, and the expected `Cache-Control` header was
not preserved.

disk.

`test/production/app-dir/isr-cache-control-restart/` to verify cache
behavior after a server restart.

restarting the server returned a `STALE` cache status instead of `HIT`.

Koppers","email":"tobias.koppers@googlemail.com","date":"2026-10-20T19:33:03Z"},"committer":{"name":"GitHub","email":"noreply@github.com","date":"2026-10-20T19:33:03Z"},"message":"Defer app router HMR refresh until the router is initialized (#100113)

### What?

In dev, an app-router HMR refresh that arrives before the app router has
initialized is no longer dropped. It now runs once the router mounts.
Several early requests are coalesced into the newest one.

### Why?

`client/app-index.tsx` opens the HMR WebSocket before the initial RSC
payload resolves and before `hydrateRoot`. `dispatch` is only set when
`useActionQueue` renders. If an `ADDED_PAGE` / `REMOVED_PAGE` /
`SERVER_COMPONENT_CHANGES` / `STATIC_PARAMS_CHANGED` message arrives in
that window, `hmrRefresh()` throws `Internal Next.js error: Router
action dispatched before initialization.` and the refresh is lost. The
page then keeps showing stale content until a manual reload.

This shows up as the second failure mode of
`test/e2e/app-dir/not-found/basic` › "should render the 404 page when
the file is removed, and restore the page when re-added". The page is
removed, the browser full-reloads to the 404, and the "page re-added"
refresh arrives during hydration. The page stays on "Root Not Found" and
the restore assertion times out.

### How?

The race is resolved in `use-action-queue.ts`, where `dispatch` is
initialized:

- `dispatchAppRouterAction`: in dev, an `ACTION_HMR_REFRESH` that
arrives while `dispatch` is still `null` is stored as the pending HMR
refresh instead of throwing. A later early refresh replaces it. Its
`AbortSignal` belongs to the newest generation, since `hmrRefresh`
already aborts superseded ones.
- Once `dispatch` exists, a new HMR refresh clears any older pending one
before dispatching. `dispatch` is assigned during render, before the
mount effect runs, so this stops a stale (already aborted) refresh from
being replayed after a newer one.
- `useActionQueue` dispatches the pending refresh from a dev-only mount
effect, inside `startTransition`. It never dispatches during render.
- Every other action still throws `Router action dispatched before
initialization`. Production is unchanged; everything is behind the
existing `NODE_ENV` checks.
- `hot-reloader-app.tsx` is unchanged from canary. The earlier
`deferred-hmr-refresh.ts` helper, its `HotReload` effect and its
callback invariant are gone.

### Verification

Full test file, `pnpm test-dev-webpack`, CI env
(`NEXT_TEST_REACT_VERSION=18.3.1`,
`__NEXT_EXPERIMENTAL_STRICT_ROUTE_TYPES=true`):

| | Runs | `before initialization` errors | Failures |
|---|---|---|---|
| with only #100112 | 10 | 2 | 2 (both at the restore step) |
| with #100112 + this PR | 10 | 0 | 0 |

- `pnpm test-dev-turbo` passed 3/3 with both PRs, and `pnpm
test-start-webpack` passed.

New integration test
`test/development/app-dir/hmr-refresh-before-hydration`:
- It holds the page before the router initializes by stalling the chunk
of a user `app/global-error.tsx`, matched by a marker string in the
chunk's source so it works with both bundlers' chunk names.
- The initial Flight payload references the global error component as a
*value*, which blocks the payload until that chunk loads.
- A client component rendered as an element wouldn't work, because
element references are lazy.
  - The main runtime still loads and opens the real HMR socket.
- The test edits the server page twice, waits until the browser has
received both `serverComponentChanges` messages, then releases the
chunk. It asserts that the latest content appears without a full reload,
and that the router-before-initialization error doesn't show up.

| | webpack dev | Turbopack dev |
|---|---|---|
| without the fix | fails: `before` stays, and the router error is
thrown for each change | same |
| with the fix (`NEXT_TEST_MAX_RETRIES=0`) | 5/5 pass | 5/5 pass |

After the move into `use-action-queue.ts`:
- The integration test passed 5/5 again on both bundlers.
- Disabling the deferral makes it fail again on webpack.
- The full not-found file passed 3/3 with #100112 applied, in the CI
env.
- A local harness (not committed) checked the ordering where a newer
refresh arrives after render but before the mount effect: removing the
clear makes exactly that case fail.

This PR is independent of #100112, which fixes the other root cause of
the same flake (a webpack dev manifest read while the file is
half-written).
